vision.problem: Finding the true lowest price on a specific laptop configuration is broken. Google Shopping mixes in ads and misses deals, spec filtering is unreliable across retailers, and users end up manually checking 5-10 retailer tabs.
vision.targetUser: Tech-savvy deal hunters, college students on a budget, and small business owners buying 1-2 machines. Know what specs matter but site should be approachable for less technical users.
vision.hook: Broader coverage than gaming-only sites (work, gaming, Apple), tracks more retailers than Google Shopping, and zero ads in results. Clean, honest price comparisons.

features.name: Category browsing
features.description: Work, Gaming, Apple sections with persistent nav tabs

features.name: Spec filtering
features.description: CPU, GPU (with specific model search like RTX 5080Ti), RAM, storage, screen size, resolution, refresh rate, weight, display type, battery life, touchscreen, OS

features.name: Brand filtering
features.description: Dell, Lenovo, HP, ASUS, Acer, MSI, Apple, Razer, Samsung, LG, etc.

features.name: Sorting
features.description: Price low-to-high, price high-to-low, biggest discount %, best reviewed, newest

features.name: Search bar
features.description: Always visible in top right. Text search by laptop name, model number, keyword, or minimum spec requirements. Typeahead suggestions.

features.name: Laptop card display
features.description: Key specs, image, top 3 lowest prices with retailer names, deal rating badge (Great Price/Fair Price/Above Average)

features.name: Laptop detail page
features.description: Full specs, price from each tracked retailer with 'Buy at [Retailer] — $[price]' rows, external review score, buy links

features.name: Best Laptops section
features.description: Aggregated review scores from external sources

features.name: Side-by-side comparison
features.description: Compare checkbox on cards, sticky bottom tray 'Compare (2 of 3)', up to 3 laptops, 'Compare Now' button, 'Clear all'

visual.layout: Dense but not cramped, left sidebar filters, card grid
visual.mode: Light mode default, no dark mode in v1
visual.hero: CarGurus-style interactive selector on landing page

copy.tagline: Top computers. Clear comparisons. Lowest prices.
copy.hero: Every laptop. Every retailer. Side by side.
copy.emptyState: No laptops match your filters. Try broadening your search.
copy.errorState: Something went wrong. We're on it — try refreshing in a moment.
copy.comparisonTray: Compare (X of 3) | Compare Now | Clear all

thirdParty.name: Custom scraper - Major retailers
thirdParty.purpose: Newegg, B&H Photo, Micro Center, Adorama

thirdParty.name: Custom scraper - Warehouse/general
thirdParty.purpose: Costco, Sam's Club, Target, Office Depot, Staples

public: GET /api/laptops/[slug] — Full detail with all retailer prices
GET /api/filters — Dynamic filter values for UI
cron: POST /api/cron/refresh-prices — Fetch prices from all retailers (every 30 min)
POST /api/cron/compute-deals — Recalculate deal ratings + denormalized fields
api.security: CRON_SECRET header for cron endpoints, rate limiting 100 req/min per IP
api.caching: List endpoints 60s, detail pages 30s via Cache-Control + Vercel edge

data: Retailer API down → Skip retailer, keep stale prices, log failure
Price $0 or negative → Reject during ingestion
Duplicate laptops → Match by manufacturer + model, Gemini normalizes names
Stale price >2 hours → Warning badge 'Price may be outdated'
ui: No filter results → 'No laptops match your filters' + Clear all button
Slow response → Skeleton loading cards (6 cards)
Image load failure → Generic laptop silhouette SVG with brand
Long laptop name → 2-line truncation on cards, full on detail
comparison: 1 laptop → Disable Compare Now, 'Add at least 2'
Navigate away → Preserve state in URL params
